about.title: About 4seasons
about.p1: 4seasons is a personal color diagnosis tool. Upload a screenshot of your character, and AI analyzes the skin, hair, and eye colors to determine which of the four seasonal types (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) suits your character best.
about.p2: Based on the diagnosis, the tool recommends in-game dyes that suit your character and ones to avoid. It helps you objectively understand which colors truly look good on your character when you're exploring new glamour directions.

usage.title: How to Use
usage.step1: Prepare a screenshot that clearly shows your character's face
usage.step2: Drag & drop the image to the upload area, or pick a file via "Choose Image"
usage.step4: Within seconds, your seasonal type and recommended/avoid dye lists appear
usage.step5: Use "Save" to copy the share URL, or "Share" to post to social media

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, it's completely free with no account required.
faq.a2: Images are used only for AI diagnosis and are not used to train AI models. They are not permanently stored on the server.
faq.q3: Any tips for taking a good screenshot?
faq.a3: A clear front or slightly angled shot showing the character's face, hair, and eyes works best. Take photos in bright lighting and avoid shadows that darken the face.
faq.q4: How many times can I use it per day?
faq.a4: There's a daily limit on diagnoses. Once you reach the limit, diagnoses are unavailable for the rest of the day and reset the next day.
faq.q5: Is this an official Square Enix tool?
faq.a5: No, this is an unofficial tool individually developed by a player.
